content:
Tentu! Agar judulnya **tepat,inovatif, dan benar-benar mengisi research gap**, saya perlu mempersempit fokus Anda. AGV terlalu luas — riset gap-nya sangat bergantung pada **sub-bidang** yang Anda minati.

Berikut **5 kategori research gap AGV yang sedang trend (2023–2025)** — pilih **satu** yang paling cocok dengan kemampuan/fasilitas Anda:

---

### 🎯 **1. Navigasi & Path Planning di Lingkungan Dinamis/Tidak Terstruktur**
**Gap:** Kebanyakan penelitian masih asumsikan lingkungan statis (pabrik bersih, lantai rata). Realita: manusia bergerak, obstacle tiba-tiba, lantai licin/berlubang, cahaya berubah.
- **Contoh judul potensial:**
  - *"Adaptive DWA-RRT* Fusion for AGV Navigation in Dynamic Industrial Environments with Moving Obstacles"*
  - *"Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Local Planner for AGVs in Unstructured Outdoor Logistics Yards"*

---

### 🎯 **2. Multi-AGV Coordination & Fleet Management (Swarm/Fleet)**
**Gap:** Single AGV sudah matang. Tantangan sekarang: **heterogeneous fleet** (AGV + AMR + manusia), *task allocation* real-time, *deadlock avoidance* tanpa server sentral, komunikasi *low-latency* (5G/TSN).
- **Contoh judul potensial:**
  - *"Decentralized Task Allocation for Heterogeneous AGV Fleets using Graph Neural Networks and Consensus ADMM"*
  - *"Deadlock-Free Multi-AGV Routing in Narrow Aisles via Priority-based Conflict Resolution"*

---

### 🎯 **3. Sensor Fusion & Lokalisasi Tanpa Infrastruktur Mahal (LiDAR/Visual SLAM)**
**Gap:** Magnetic tape/QR code mahal & rapuh. GPS tidak bekerja indoor. Visual/LiDAR SLAM rentan *drift*, *feature-poor* (dinding polos), *dynamic objects*, cahaya ekstrem.
- **Contoh judul potensial:**
  - *"Lightweight LiDAR-Visual-Inertial SLAM for Low-Cost AGVs in Feature-Poor Warehouse Corridors"*
  - *"Robust Localization for AGVs using Floor-Texture Visual Odometry Fused with Wheel Encoder under Slip Conditions"*

---

### 🎯 **4. Energy-Aware & Green AGV Operation**
**Gap:** Baterai jadi *bottleneck*. Charging scheduling, *energy-optimal path planning*, *regenerative braking*, *battery health-aware routing* masih minim.
- **Contoh judul potensial:**
  - *"Joint Charging Scheduling and Energy-Optimal Path Planning for Battery-Constrained AGV Fleets"*
  - *"Battery Health-Aware Routing for Lithium-Ion Powered AGVs using Electrochemical Model Integration"*

---

### 🎯 **5. Safety & Human-AGV Collaboration (HRC) — ISO 3691-4 / ISO 10218**
**Gap:** Standar baru butuh *real-time human intention prediction*, *speed and separation monitoring (SSM)*, *collision avoidance* yang *provably safe* (bukan hanya heuristik).
- **Contoh judul potensial:**
  - *"Intent-Aware Safe Trajectory Planning for AGVs in Shared Human-Robot Workspaces using Bayesian Inference"*
  - *"Formal Verification of SSM Controller for AGVs under Sensor Uncertainty and Communication Delay"*

---

## 🔍 **Pertanyaan cepat untuk menentukan arah:**

| Pertanyaan | Jawaban Anda |
|------------|--------------|
| **Fasilitas hardware apa yang tersedia?** (LiDAR 2D/3D? Kamera? IMU? Robot fisik? Simulasi saja?) | |
| **Keahlian tim:** Lebih kuat di **Control/Robotics**, **AI/ML**, **Embedded/IoT**, atau **Operations Research/Optimization**? | |
| **Target publikasi:** Conference (ICRA, IROS, CASE, ICAR) atau Journal (T-RO, T-ASE, T-II, Automation in Construction, Robotics and CIM)? | |
| **Apakah ada data eksperimen nyata atau hanya simulasi?** | |

---

**Balas dengan nomor kategori (1–5) + jawaban 4 pertanyaan di atas** — saya akan buatkan **3–5 judul spesifik** yang *gap-nya jelas, metodologi terstruktur, dan cocok untuk IEEE*. 🚀
